text:
jamie: Quick thought — propose we switch the weekly triage to a compact 30m format and rotate ownership every week. Agenda idea: quick backlog sweep (10m), bug queue triage (10m), owner assignments + blockers (10m). Start next Wed. Also propose alternating biweekly deep-dive/RFC reviews outside the compact slot. Who's up for a rotation?
sara: +1. 👍 Can we keep deep-dives biweekly only and keep compact as the default weekly? Also prefer the start at 9:30 PT if possible.
nate: +1 to compact. Can we reserve a 2-minute emergency slot for blocking deploys (quick ping)? BTW 10am PT is a conflict for infra standup for me.
lee: I can take week 1 (next Wed). I'll update the shared doc and send the calendar invite. Need a backup — @priya?
priya: I can be backup for the first two weeks. Small ask: add a short pre-read doc so folks can triage async before the call.
alex: Agreed on pre-reads. I'll draft a tiny checklist: severity (P0/P1/P2), owner, ETA, suggested action.
jamie: Lean checklist + hard timeboxes — yes. I'll set the calendar to 9:30–10:00 PT for the compact slot. If we need more time we open a follow-up. Deep-dive every other Wed at 10:15 (30m).
sara: Can we include a 3-minute 'code-review unblock' callout at the end so people can ping reviewers?
nate: Add rotation table to the doc. Lee — can you paste the schedule when you update?
lee: Sure. Quick paste into the doc now:
```
W1: lee (backup priya)
W2: nate (backup alex)
W3: sara (backup jamie)
W4: alex (backup lee)
```
I can swap if needed.
devops-bot: Reminder: please name the calendar event 'Redwood: Compact Triage' and include dial-in + autopopulated agenda.
jamie: Thanks @devops-bot. Lee — can you send the invite by EOD? If not, I'll do it tomorrow morning.
lee: Sending now. Doc link (stub): https://docs.google.com/triage-compact — please add tickets to the 'to-review' section before the call.
priya: Adding my list. Also: can we auto-tag the bug queue in Jira with `triage-bug` so the doc auto-updates? @alex can you take this automation?
alex: On it. I'll add a Jira rule to tag P0/P1 with `triage-bug` and hook the page. ETA: today.
sara: :thumbsup: small ask — can we record deep-dives to S3 for async watchers? Compact triage probably doesn't need recording.
jamie: Good call. Deep-dives = record, compact = no. We'll try this cadence for 4 weeks and then retro.
nate: ✅ updating my calendar now.
lee: Invite created (sent). I'll also add the rotation table and checklist to the doc. See you all next Wed.
